tips.q: What makes a high-CTR YouTube thumbnail prompt?
tips.a: Three ingredients: (1) a single dominant subject with exaggerated facial expression, (2) one bold sans-serif headline ≤ 4 words at high contrast, (3) one accent prop or arrow. Specify 1280×720, name the emotion, and quote the exact title text — vague prompts produce flat thumbnails that don't earn clicks.

tips.q: How do I render large headline text without garbling?
tips.a: Wrap the exact string in double quotes (`title: "INSANE STRATEGY"`), keep it under 20 characters, and request `bold sans-serif, ultra-high contrast, black stroke`. Use the JSON template in this library — its title_text block fixes font weight, position, and color so GPT Image 2 doesn't improvise the typography.

tips.q: What aspect ratio and resolution should YouTube thumbnails use?
tips.a: Standard videos: 1280×720 at 16:9. Shorts: 1080×1920 at 9:16. Always render at 2K (10 credits) so text stays sharp after YouTube re-encodes. Specify the resolution in your prompt — leaving it default produces 1024×1024 squares that get center-cropped on the watch page.

tips.q: How do I keep my face recognizable across episodes?
tips.a: Upload the same well-lit reference photo every time and add `preserve facial features and hairstyle exactly` to each prompt. Reuse one JSON template and only swap the headline, expression, and background — that locks identity while letting the niche styling change between gaming, podcast, and review uploads.

faq.q: What's the best AI prompt for a YouTube thumbnail?
faq.a: Reliable template: 'Create a 1280×720 YouTube thumbnail. Subject: [you/topic] with [exaggerated emotion]. Background: [bold gradient / scene]. Add bold sans-serif text: "[YOUR TITLE]" in [color]. High contrast, sharp focus, clickbait composition.' GPT Image 2 renders the text correctly first try, which Midjourney/SDXL fail at.

faq.q: Can GPT Image 2 add text to thumbnails?
faq.a: Yes — this is GPT Image 2's strongest advantage. Pixel-level text rendering means your thumbnail title shows up readable and styled, no Photoshop overlay needed. Use double quotes around the exact text you want.

faq.q: How to make YouTube thumbnails for gaming with AI?
faq.a: Use this gaming template: 'YouTube gaming thumbnail, [game character/me] with shocked face, neon explosion background, dramatic lighting, bold red text "INSANE [game] STRATEGY", high contrast, 1280×720.' Layer in game-specific elements (Fortnite skin / Minecraft block / Valorant gun) for niche fit.

faq.q: What size should AI-generated YouTube thumbnails be?
faq.a: Always 1280×720 (16:9) for standard videos, 1080×1920 (9:16) for Shorts. Specify the size explicitly in your prompt — GPT Image 2's 2K output mode is ideal for HD thumbnails. Smaller resolutions look blurry on TVs.

faq.q: Is GPT Image 2 free for thumbnail creation?
faq.a: Studio offers free trial credits. 1 thumbnail at 2K = 10 credits. For high-volume creators (3 thumbnails/week), our credit packs are cheaper than Canva Pro / Photoshop subscriptions and faster than designer-on-demand.
